definitions.explanation: The second son born in a family. In traditional Japanese family structure, the second son typically did not inherit the household, unlike the eldest son.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}{人|にん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{次男|じなん}だ。
examples.english: He is the second son of three brothers.

examples.japanese: {次男|じなん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Our second son will enter elementary school next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぎ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧、{次男|じなん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だった。
examples.english: In the past, the eldest son would inherit the household, and the second son would strike out on his own.

notes:
{次男|じなん} means second son. Part of the Japanese birth-order system that is commonly used in daily life, official documents, and family registers (⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧).

BIRTH ORDER - SONS:
- ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧: eldest son
- {次男|じなん}: second son
- ⟦{三男|さんなん}→三男：10689_sannan⟧: third son

BIRTH ORDER - DAUGHTERS:
- ⟦{長女|ちょうじょ}→長女：14518_choujo⟧: eldest daughter
- ⟦{次女|じじょ}→次女：15831_jijo⟧: second daughter
- ⟦{三女|さんじょ}→三女：10690_sanjo⟧: third daughter

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese families, the ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧ often bears special responsibilities like inheriting the family home and caring for elderly parents. The {次男|じなん} historically had more freedom. This distinction has weakened in modern times but still influences family dynamics.
